source: Local decrypted English ELF plus item.bin, complete_arms.bin and arms_param_ps3.bin.

specialMatch.precedence: First matching row, then first slot, then second slot.

native.speedDisplay: Sign-extend pair speed byte, add 3, then use the native Speed label table.

scope: Ordered katana and kodachi combined Attack, Force and Speed from the native getter. These values do not establish final combat damage or the full meaning of Force.
outsideCompletionNote: Ten other item-mapped weapons are retained for source coverage. Inclusion does not establish ordinary acquisition.
audit: Private weapon-pair audit retained outside the public repository.
